text: I find myself in a space that celebrates inquiry and innovation, yet carries an air of anticipation. The glass-walled room, with its empty chairs and pristine meeting tables, feels like the threshold of collaboration—a place where ideas either await birth or have just been spirited away. The exhibit wall outside, dedicated to R+D, radiates creativity and the pursuit of knowledge. I feel quietly inspired, as if the walls themselves urge me to reflect on the nature and value of progress. There is a hum of possibility here, mixed with the silent invitation to contribute my own questions and insights.
